01

A monitor for your saved properties

Export an n8n workflow containing the HPD building IDs you actually saved. It checks records, compares the previous snapshot and produces a change report.

Not connected. Import and publish the workflow in your own n8n instance to schedule it.

02

Evidence you can share

Export a dated property dossier with tax-lot characteristics, registered contacts, open HPD records and ACRIS documents when available. Open it in a browser to print or save as PDF.

ACRIS document amounts are not market valuations. HPD coverage is limited. No listing feed, seller intent prediction, or beneficial-owner verification is provided.
